ns2:course.label: Multimedia Environmental Communications
ns2:course.description: Students will develop capacities to communicate with a broad audience about sustainability and the environment. Storytelling and clear exposition across multiple platforms will be emphasized, including blogs, audio podcasts and short videos, among others. In addition, students in the course will have the opportunity to partner with campus units and other local organizations to create materials that will be useful for real-world outreach and education efforts as well as credit in the course. Same as ENGL 467. 3 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit.
